description: Second, independent demand signal (from 2026-10-21): for each popular city, the top-20 overseas packages on Hanatour (Korea's largest travel agency) sorted by the site's own "most booked" order, with cumulative review counts, ratings, adult-min prices, departure-fixed flags, the number of packages on sale per city, and the site's top-10 search keywords with search counts; each with 30-day history. Ordinal rank only (no absolute booking counts) — do not merge with the Naver buyer index; read trends separately. Omit city for an all-cities summary. 하나투어 도시별 예약순 상위 20(순위·누적 후기·평점·최저가·출발확정)·판매 상품 수·인기 검색어 10. 네이버 구매 인원과 다른 종류의 신호라 합산 금지.
